# Avani Enterprises

> Avani Enterprises is a leading web development, software, and digital marketing agency headquartered in Gurugram (DLF Cyber City), Haryana, India. The company builds high-performance websites, custom business software (CRM, HR portals, business operating systems), AI automation, and runs high-ROI SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and social media campaigns for businesses across North India and major Indian cities.

## Key facts

- Name: Avani Enterprises
- Headquarters: DLF Cyber City, Gurugram, Haryana 122002, India
- Founded: 2016 (8+ years of experience)
- Track record: 150+ clients, 300+ projects delivered
- Phone: +91 92536 25099
- Email: kp@avanienterprises.in
- Primary service regions: Haryana, Delhi NCR (Gurgaon, Noida, Greater Noida, Ghaziabad, Faridabad), Rohtak, Panipat, Karnal, Sonipat, Hisar, Ambala, Chandigarh, plus Mumbai, Pune, and pan-India.

## Services

- **Web Development**: Custom websites, web applications, ecommerce stores, and custom software using React, Next.js, and Node.js. https://www.avanienterprises.in/web-development-company
- **SEO**: Technical SEO, on-page optimization, local SEO, content, and link building for durable organic growth. https://www.avanienterprises.in/seo-company
- **Digital Marketing**: Full-funnel strategy across SEO, paid media, and social to generate qualified leads and ROI. https://www.avanienterprises.in/digital-marketing-company
- **Google Ads / PPC**: Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and display campaign management focused on cost per lead. https://www.avanienterprises.in/google-ads-agency
- **AI Automation**: AI chatbots, WhatsApp automation, workflow automation, and custom AI tools. https://www.avanienterprises.in/ai-automation-company
- **CRM Development**: Custom CRM software for lead, sales, and customer management. https://www.avanienterprises.in/crm-development-company
- **Business Software**: HR portals, HRMS, payroll, attendance, and business operating systems. https://www.avanienterprises.in/business-operating-system
- **Social Media Marketing, Meta Ads & Branding**: Content, community building, and paid social on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.
